summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Listing Rules, disclosing an ongoing share buyback program. On June 5, 2026, the issuer exercised options for 6,000 new shares at USD 2.252 per share. More significantly, the filing details numerous open-market share repurchases for cancellation from March 20 to April 13, 2026, totaling tens of thousands of shares at prices ranging roughly from USD 6.57 to USD 6.82. This is a capital return via buyback. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is routine disclosure, but the aggregate buyback represents a notable reduction in shares outstanding. Watch for continued execution under the buyback mandate and potential impact on earnings per share.
